product.name: Supply Chain Financing Platform for Pharma
product.description: A fintech platform providing credit and payment solutions tailored for pharmaceutical retailers and distributors to manage working capital and cash flow.

product.name: InstaCash
product.description: A quick cash disbursement service providing instant working capital to pharma retailers and distributors.

product.name: InstaPay
product.description: A payment solution enabling pharma businesses to pay suppliers instantly and securely.

product.name: Interest Aligned Payment
product.description: A financing model where users pay interest only for the duration they use the borrowed funds.

product.name: FundlyMart
product.description: A procurement platform offering pharma retailers access to exclusive deals and discounts from distributors.

product.name: Pharma Retail Insurance
product.description: An insurance product tailored for pharmaceutical retailers to protect against sector-specific risks.
